biography: Junior Lara Campos hails from the bustling favelas of São Paulo, a world away from the glitz and glamour he now chases on the racetrack. He didn't grow up karting like many of his rivals; instead, his first taste of speed was dodging traffic on a beat-up scooter, delivering groceries for his family. One fateful day, he stumbled upon an underground street racing scene, captivated by the roar of engines and the raw skill on display. He scraped together enough money to buy a clapped-out Fusca, affectionately nicknamed 'The Roach,' and began honing his skills on the unforgiving city streets. His aggressive style and fearless overtaking maneuvers quickly earned him a reputation. He caught the eye of Fusca HC2 during a local race and has been with the team ever since, a constant reminder of his humble beginnings fueling his relentless pursuit of victory. Now, Junior is looking to elevate his career and prove his worth to the greater racing community.
drivingStyle: Junior's driving style is a reflection of his upbringing: raw, aggressive, and always on the edge. He's known for his late-braking maneuvers and daring overtakes, often pushing the limits of his car and tires. While some criticize his lack of finesse, his supporters admire his unwavering commitment to attacking every corner as if it were his last. He struggles with tire management, often sacrificing early pace for a blistering final lap, a trait that has both won him races and cost him dearly. He thrives under pressure, relishing the challenge of wheel-to-wheel combat, a skill honed in the chaotic world of underground racing.

rivalries.name: Ricardo Oliveira
rivalries.reason: A long-standing feud stemming from a controversial collision during the Brazilian National Fusca Championship, where Junior accused Ricardo of deliberately blocking him.

rivalries.name: Isabela Vargas
rivalries.reason: Isabela and Junior often clash on the track, known for their fierce battles and unwillingness to yield. Their rivalry is fuelled by contrasting driving styles – her precise and calculated versus his aggressive and instinctive.

quirks: Always wears a faded wristband that his grandmother gave him before every race.
Listens to a specific Brazilian funk song ('Favela Victory') right before putting on his helmet.
Has a pre-race ritual of drawing a small 'X' on his steering wheel with a permanent marker.
famousQuote: You either push or get pushed. There's no in-between in life, or on the track.
careerHighlight: Winning the Brazilian National Fusca Championship in 2022. He started last due to a mechanical issue and fought his way through the pack, executing a daring last-lap overtake to secure the victory.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final race of the 2023 season, costing him a chance at the championship title. The crash was attributed to his aggressive driving style and pushing the car beyond its limits.
